claims.value: GLM-5 is a large language model with 744B parameters (40B active), scaled from GLM-4.5's 355B (32B active). It integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to reduce deployment costs while preserving long-context capacity. It targets complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks, achieving best-in-class open-source performance on reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks.
claims.evidence: GLM-5 scales from 355B parameters (32B active) to 744B parameters (40B active)... integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), largely reducing deployment cost while preserving long-context capacity... targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks
